blocks.x: Upstream and downstream operators run hazardous physics under volatile markets: predictive integrity, energy efficiency, trading precision and OT security decide both margin and license to operate. Every program must respect process-safety culture from day one. This page is the operating picture: what runs, what strains, and which capabilities move the numbers that decide the margin.

The work concentrates in integrity management, turnaround scheduling, trading and scheduling, with emissions monitoring close behind. Each of these paths produces data faster than decisions, and the gap between the two is where cost and risk accumulate.
named from the floor, not from a framework, Oil & Gas edition:

items: Pipelines, separators and rotating equipment hold failure precursors nobody sees; integrity runs on schedules.
Convergence and legacy SCADA create attack paths with physical consequence; 62443 incomplete.
APC setpoints static while feedstock shifts; energy and yield losses accepted.
Intraday opportunities missed; scheduling/bidding on spreadsheets.
Emissions data assembled by estimate; auditors and buyers demand measurement.
Turnaround and maintenance scheduling combinatorial; downtime too long.

blocks.x: Capability in Oil & Gas is not abstract: each domain lands as a named build on a named workflow. The patterns below are what we deploy there.
